questions.question: What kind of king was Hezekiah of Judah?
options: A good king who trusted the LORD and removed idols
A weak and idle king who did nothing at all
A wicked king who led the whole of Judah deep into sin
A foreign ruler set up over them by Assyria
questions.answer: A good king who trusted the LORD and removed idols

questions.question: Which Assyrian king invaded Judah and besieged its cities?
